# `<sl-resize-observer>` — Resize Observer

The Resize Observer component offers a thin, declarative interface to the [`ResizeObserver API`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/ResizeObserver).

**Status:** stable · **Since:** 2.0

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/resize-observer/resize-observer.js';`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the observer. |

## Events

Listen with `addEventListener`, `(event-name)` in Angular or `@event-name` in Lit. Data is on `event.detail`.

| Event | `event.detail` | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sl-resize` | `{ entries: ResizeObserverEntry[] }` | Emitted when the element is resized. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | One or more elements to watch for resizing. |

## Documentation and examples

The resize observer will report changes to the dimensions of the elements it wraps through the `sl-resize` event. When emitted, a collection of [`ResizeObserverEntry`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/ResizeObserverEntry) objects will be attached to `event.detail` that contains the target element and information about its dimensions.

```html
<div class="resize-observer-overview">
  <sl-resize-observer>
    <div>Resize this box and watch the console 👉</div>
  </sl-resize-observer>
</div>

<script>
  const container = document.querySelector('.resize-observer-overview');
  const resizeObserver = container.querySelector('sl-resize-observer');

  resizeObserver.addEventListener('sl-resize', event => {
    console.log(event.detail);
  });
</script>

<style>
  .resize-observer-overview div {
    display: flex;
    border: solid 2px var(--sl-input-border-color);
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 4rem 2rem;
  }
</style>
```
